newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Islamic militants win West Bank student election.
newsitem.headline: Islamic militants win West Bank student election.

text.p: Supporters of Islamic militant groups on Tuesday won the largest number of seats in a West Bank student election seen as a test of strength between the PLO and rival groups.

Musa Abu Daiyeh, director of student affairs at an-Najah university, said a coalition grouping backers of Hamas and Islamic Jihad groups, which oppose PLO peace moves with Israel, won 39 out of 81 seats on the student assembly.
PLO faction opposed to the peace moves won six seats and a list associated with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's Fatah movement won the remaining 36.
"The election has taken place in a democratic and honest atmoshpere without any interruptions," said Abu Daiyeh.
Nearly 6,800 students took part in the vote.
Palestinians often view elections for student and professional unions as barometers of public opinion on national issues like support for the PLO and peace with Israel.
Palestinians held their first general elections in January for a president and an 88-member legislative council. Hamas and Islamic Jihad officially boycotted the elections.
